meta.title: Publishing or withdrawing an event updates the "in progress" quantity on its PR items
gaps: the decisive step tests something else than the case's point: The setup cannot create two events, distinguish PR from BOQ, or create multiple line items.
No operation can delete one line item before publishing.
The available line-item read-back does not expose an in-progress quantity field, so quantity recomputation and stale values cannot be verified.
The plan does not separately publish and withdraw both the PR event and the BOQ event.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with one line item and no rounds.
steps: As the buyer, list the event's line items and check that Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: Status check: the reply's status code is a success (2xx — the request worked).
